services.name: Past Exhibitions
services.desc: In this exhibition of 62 works created by members of the Northern California/Northern Nevada region of Studio Art Quilt Associates (SAQA), viewers will be immersed in the flow of a color wheel. Each work-all created in the same size-is monochromatic in design but unique in theme, subject, and construction. Presented together, they create a vibrant spectrum unveiling the world of color that artists throughout the ages have explored. Since the mid-19th century, artists have ventured beyond their studios to paint out of doors, exploring and experimenting with light, color, and mood as they work directly in nature. services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: Discover Art field trips for regional schools include tours with a trained docent through our gallery and a hands-on art lesson in our studio. Each student leaves the field trip with new knowledge relevant to their school curriculum, and a work of art that they made themselves. The CAC offers field trips during the Fall and Spring

services.name: Rentals page
services.desc: Read the Frequently Asked Questions section to make sure the Carnegie Arts Center (CAC) will meet your rental needs. To initiate a reservation, event organizers should submit a completed event application, including the non-refundable $50.00 application fee. Upon approval of your application, you will be sent a CAC Rental Agreement and estimated invoice for your event. Return the Rental Agreement with a deposit of at least 50% of the estimated rental fee within 30 days of approval. Your reservation is not finalized until a completed Rental Agreement and 50% deposit are received. The remaining fees and proof of insurance are due in full no later than 15 days prior to the event.
